extracted.name: Oatmeal cookies
extracted.description: Some like it chewy and others like it crisp, It took me a while to develop this best chewy soft oatmeal chocolate chip cookies recipe.
instruction_lines: Mix all the wet ingredients in a large mixing bowl: oil, brown and white sugar, egg + egg yolk, vanilla, cranberries and walnuts until it well blended. combine all dry ingredients in a mixing bowl: flour, oatmeal, cinnamon, baking soda and salt. add the dry mix to the wet and stir just until combined.
Form the dough in to a small balls using tsp and place 5 cm apart on a prepared baking sheet.
Preheat the oven to 180c and bake for 7 minutes.
Let cool completely on the baking sheet. store it in airtight container for 4-5 days.
